The facts: a public official (副局长) in environmental protection bureau, signed false documents certifying project completion, leading to illegal disbursement of special funds: 240 million? Actually 240万元 and 116.21万元. This is misuse of authority to approve non-completed projects to obtain funds. Likely crime: "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and "挪用公款"? But he didn't appropriate funds for personal use; he caused the government to pay to the operating unit. The crime could be "职务侵占" (occupying public funds) or "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds). However, the official didn't take the money himself; he caused the unit to receive funds. The appropriate crime is "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and "徇私舞弊" (maybe). Also "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power) when a state functionary abuses authority causing loss. The facts: He knowingly signed false completion reports, causing illegal disbursement of funds. That is "滥用职权罪" (abuse of power). Also could be "受贿罪"? No, no mention of receiving bribes. "挪用公款罪" requires the person misappropriates public funds for personal use. Not here. "职务侵占罪" also requires appropriation. Not here. So likely "滥用职权罪". Also "徇私舞弊罪" maybe if he colluded with the operating unit for personal benefit? Not indicated. So answer: [罪名]滥用职权<eoa>.
